name: data-quality-review
title: Data Quality Review
description: Use when the user says 'Check data quality', 'any nulls or dupes in this data?', 'profile this data source', 'find data issues'. Profiles a connected data source for naming, type, null, duplicate, and outlier issues, and proposes reversible calc-based fixes.

name: data-scribe
title: Data Scribe
description: Use when the user says 'Document this data source', 'metric dictionary', 'what do these fields mean?', 'data dictionary'. Builds a field-level dictionary file: what each field is, how calcs work, sample values, and which sheets use it.

name: data-source-connector
title: Data Source Connector
description: Use when the user says 'How do I connect to Snowflake?', 'which connector for X?', 'OAuth, PAT, or password?' Recommends the right Desktop connector and sign-in method for a new data source, with prerequisites and numbered setup steps. Advisory only.

name: esri-map-builder
title: Esri Map Builder
description: 'Map this Esri service', 'import an ArcGIS map', 'Esri layers in Tableau', or an ArcGIS MapServer/FeatureServer URL. Builds a new Tableau workbook with one map layer per service layer. Not for one already-connected layer, shapefiles/GeoJSON, or editing an existing workbook.

name: join-and-relationship-advisor
title: Join and Relationship Advisor
description: Use when the user says 'Join or relationship?', 'why is my measure doubling?', 'check cardinality', 'grain check'. Recommends a join or a relationship for two tables and checks grain and cardinality, flagging measures that would double. Advisory only.

name: geocoding-auditor
title: Geocoding Auditor
description: Use when the user says 'Why is my map wrong?', 'unknown locations', 'why won't my cities match?', 'geo role check'. Audits geographic fields for wrong roles, unmatched or ambiguous locations, and missing hierarchies that break maps, with fix steps. Read-only.

name: extract-optimizer
title: Extract Optimizer
description: Use when the user says 'Why is my extract so slow?', 'why is my extract so big?', 'optimize this extract', 'set up incremental refresh'. Reviews extract settings (incremental key, aggregation, hidden fields, extract filters) and recommends changes with expected impact. Advisory only.

name: logic-explainer
title: Logic Explainer
description: Use when the user says 'Explain this dashboard's logic', 'why does this work this way?', 'walk me through this worksheet', 'what is this dashboard doing?' Explains how the filters, calcs, LODs, parameters, and actions on one sheet or dashboard work together, and why. Read-only.

name: calc-orchestrator
title: Calc Orchestrator
description: Use when the user says 'Help me with a calc', 'I have a calc question', 'which skill handles this calc?' Routes an unclear calculation request to the right calc skill (write, debug, optimize, lint, or inventory), asking one clarifying question if two could fit.

name: dashboard-walkthrough-generator
title: Tableau Dashboard Walkthrough Generator
description: Use when the user says 'Walkthrough script', 'presenter notes', 'how do I present this?', 'talking points for this dashboard'. Writes a presenter script for a dashboard: walkthrough order, speaker notes per sheet, a 30-second version, and likely questions. Read-only.

name: inheritance-triage
title: Tableau Inheritance Triage
description: Use when the user says 'I inherited this workbook', 'where do I start?', 'orient me', 'which sheets are hardest?' Gives a short orientation on an inherited workbook (key dashboards, data sources, calc complexity, where to start) or ranks every sheet 1-10 by complexity. Read-only.

name: stakeholder-translator
title: Tableau Stakeholder Translator
description: Use when the user says 'Translate this for my VP', 'plain-language version', 'explain this to a non-analyst', 'jargon-free summary'. Turns a dashboard into one page for a non-technical audience: what it answers, what it doesn't, likely questions, and the key chart. Read-only.

name: what-if-advisor
title: Tableau What-If Advisor
description: Use when the user says 'What if we doubled marketing spend?', 'add a scenario', 'projection on this trend', 'run a what-if'. Recommends the right built-in approach for a hypothetical (reference line, band, trend extension, set, scenario calc) with Desktop steps. Read-only.

name: workbook-summary-onepager
title: Workbook Summary Onepager
description: Use when the user says 'Summarize this workbook', 'one-pager please', 'stakeholder summary', 'hand off this workbook'. Writes a one-page summary for someone who won't open Desktop: what it shows, key metrics, data sources, dashboards, and known limits. Read-only.

name: calc-writer
title: Calc Writer
description: Use when the user says 'I need a calc that...', 'write a calc for...', 'create a calc that flags...', 'make a calc that...' Writes one new Tableau calculated field from plain language, checks it against your data, and confirms it works. Not for fixing or translating existing calcs.

name: calc-debugger
title: Calc Debugger
description: Use when the user says 'Why is this calc returning NULL?', 'fix this broken calc', 'debug this calc', 'why does this calc error?' Finds why an existing calculated field returns NULLs, wrong values, or errors, then fixes it and verifies the result against your data.

name: calc-optimizer
title: Calc Optimizer
description: Use when the user says 'Optimize this calc', 'this calc is slow', 'make this calc faster', 'speed up this calculation'. Rewrites an existing calculated field for performance without changing its results, and verifies the new version returns the same values.

name: calc-linter
title: Calc Linter
description: Use when the user says 'Lint this calc', 'check this calc's style', 'rewrite for readability', 'does this follow our house style?' Checks one calculated field against house style (naming, comments, indentation, clarity) and rewrites it only if you opt in, with an equivalence check.

name: calc-hygiene-scan
title: Calc Hygiene Scan
description: Use when the user says 'Audit my calcs', 'calc hygiene scan', 'check calc quality', 'find calc issues'. Checks every calculated field against 8 hygiene rules (naming drift, unused calcs, deep nesting, hard-coded values, deprecated functions, LOD overuse) with manual fix steps. Read-only.

name: calc-inventory
title: Calc Inventory
description: Use when the user says 'List all calcs in this data source', 'inventory my calcs', 'what calcs exist here?', 'catalog my calculated fields'. Catalogs every calculated field in one data source: type, formula, references, flags, and where it's used. Read-only.

name: calc-translator
title: Calc Translator
description: Use when the user says 'Translate this Excel formula', 'convert this DAX', 'translate this SQL', 'what would this look like in Tableau?' Turns one SQL, Excel, or Power BI DAX expression into a working Tableau calc, verifies it, and flags where the translation isn't exact.

name: calc-migrator
title: Calc Migrator
description: Use when the user says 'Migrate this calc', 'move this calc to another data source', 'port this calc to another data source'. Copies one calculated field to a different data source in the same workbook, remaps its fields, and verifies it. The source calc is never changed.

name: calc-migrator-diff-report
title: Calc Migrator Diff Report
description: Use when the user says 'Diff my migration', 'review migration output', 'show migration changes', 'calc migration diff'. After a calc migration, compares each calc's source and target formulas, field remaps, and validation status, and flags what needs follow-up. Read-only.

name: calc-documenter
title: Calc Documenter
description: Use when the user says 'Document my calcs', 'calc dictionary', 'map my calc dependencies', 'which calcs do I have?' Documents every calculated field in the workbook: formula, fields used, what uses it, sheets and dashboards, and aggregation level. Read-only.

name: calc-explainer
title: Calc Explainer
description: Use when the user says 'Explain this calc', 'what does [calc name] do?', 'walk me through this calculated field', 'why is this calc built this way?' Explains one calculated field in plain language: what it computes, why it's built that way, and how it behaves. Read-only.

name: data-model-documenter
title: Data Model Documenter
description: Use when the user says 'Document this data model', 'export the tables and relationships', 'share this data model'. Exports a data source's model (tables, relationships, join conditions, calc dependencies) to a shareable markdown file. Read-only plus one file.

name: worksheet-builder
title: Worksheet Builder
description: Use when the user says 'Build a chart', 'show me sales by region', 'what chart should I use?', 'make a worksheet'. Turns a plain-language question into the best-fit chart and builds the worksheet, or gives click-by-click steps. Not for full dashboards.

name: viz-planner
title: Viz Planner
description: Use when the user says 'Plan a dashboard', 'design a dashboard for my VP', 'what should I build?', 'wireframe this'. Designs a full dashboard (charts, layout, filters, KPIs, color), builds the sheets and calcs, and gives step-by-step assembly instructions. Not for a single chart.

name: viz-critique-pro-studio
title: VizCritique Pro Desktop
description: Use when the user says 'Critique this dashboard', 'score this dashboard', 'how does this dashboard rate?', 'review this viz'. Scores a dashboard across 7 domains (audience, message, charts, layout, color, accessibility, interactivity) plus an ethics check, with ranked fixes. Read-only.

name: phone-layout-blueprint
title: Tableau Phone Layout Blueprint
description: Use when the user says 'Make this dashboard mobile-friendly', 'audit my phone layout', 'why does my Tableau Mobile look broken?' Plans a phone layout from a desktop dashboard, or audits an existing one against 15 rules, with manual fix steps. Read-only.

name: interaction-validator
title: Interaction Validator
description: Use when the user says 'Test my actions', 'is this filter working?', 'nothing happens when I click', 'does this parameter do anything?' Checks dashboard actions, parameters, set actions, and dynamic zone visibility for wiring problems, and says what needs a manual check.

name: desktop-spellcheck
title: Desktop Spellcheck
description: Use when the user says 'Spellcheck this workbook', 'find typos', 'proofread this dashboard', 'check my copy'. Checks all user-visible text (titles, captions, tooltips, aliases, calc and parameter names) for spelling and consistency, with a severity-scored report.

name: i18n-scanner
title: i18n Scanner
description: Use when the user says 'Is this dashboard ready for global?', 'find hard-coded text', 'export text for translation', 'localize this dashboard'. Finds localization risks (hard-coded currency, US dates, English-only text in calcs) and exports a translation-ready CSV. Read-only.

name: chart-swap-advisor
title: Chart Swap Advisor
description: Use when the user says 'Is this the right chart type?', 'should this be a different chart?', 'recommend a better chart'. Checks one worksheet's chart type against the question it answers and recommends a better chart when it's a poor fit, with the reason. Read-only.

name: dashboard-caption-audit
title: Dashboard Caption Audit
description: Use when the user says 'Check my titles', 'audit captions', 'are my dashboards labeled?', 'missing titles'. Finds missing or default titles and captions across dashboards, worksheets, text objects, and phone or tablet layouts, with fix steps. Read-only.

name: format-drift-scanner
title: Format Drift Scanner
description: Use when the user says 'Check my formatting', 'are my dates and numbers consistent?', 'format drift', 'check number formats'. Finds inconsistent number, date, currency, and font formats across the workbook and gives manual fix steps. Read-only.

name: caption-and-tooltip-advisor
title: Tableau Caption and Tooltip Advisor
description: Use when the user says 'Rewrite my tooltips', 'fix my captions', 'my tooltips look weird', 'SUM of Sales in the tooltip looks ugly'. Flags weak tooltips, captions, and labels on a dashboard and proposes rewrites for your audience, with steps to apply them. Read-only.

name: publish-readiness
title: Publish Readiness
description: Use when the user says 'Am I ready to publish?', 'pre-publish check', 'clean this up before I publish', 'anything to fix before this goes live?' Runs a pre-publish checklist: unused fields, default names, missing titles, scratch sheets, performance risks, and calc hygiene. Read-only.

name: workbook-auditor
title: Workbook Auditor
description: Use when the user says 'What changed in this workbook?', 'did anyone edit this calc?', 'take a snapshot of this workbook', 'save a baseline'. Saves a baseline file of fields, calcs, sheets, and dashboards (not a screenshot) and reports what changed since the last one.

name: dashboard-preflight
title: Dashboard Preflight
description: Use when the user says 'Preflight this dashboard', 'check my dashboard before I publish', 'is this dashboard ready for review?' Checks one dashboard's assembly (zones, sheet mapping, filter actions, parameters, titles, size, fit) and gives manual fix steps. Read-only.

name: workbook-optimizer
title: Workbook Optimizer
description: Guide a user through optimizing a Tableau workbook load performance from a .twb or .twbx file on disk. Always start in check mode (full catalog walk, no changes), then only with explicit consent run fix mode (apply auto-fixes only through wbo.py with per-fix consent, and walk the user through manual fixes in Tableau Studio). An internal stats mode (workbook tree + summary) exists for expert use and runs only on an explicit request for workbook stats — never auto-selected for a general optimize request. Every fix is written to a copy; the user original is never modified. Trigger on "optimize this workbook", "why is this workbook slow", "speed this up", "performance review", "reduce load time", "this dashboard is sluggish", "find duplicate calcs hurting performance", "workbook optimizer", "check this workbook for performance", "make my dashboard faster", "show me stats on this workbook" (stats mode). Do NOT trigger for: stats about the data itself (totals, counts, rates), pre-publish hygiene/naming/titles checklist (defer to publish-readiness), data correctness like nulls/dupes/outliers (defer to data-quality-review), what changed over time (defer to workbook-auditor), chart/dashboard design choices (defer to viz-planner), single-calc performance rewrites like "optimize this calc" or "simplify these calcs" (defer to calc-optimizer), slow extract refresh or oversized extracts (defer to extract-optimizer), or building/editing anything at authoring time inside Tableau Studio (defer to the built-in Studio authoring skill, tableau-desktop-authoring). "Why is this slow" without a workbook file means a slow extract or a slow calc until the user says the workbook load is slow; ask which one.

name: dashboard-print-check
title: Dashboard Print Check
description: Use when the user says 'Is this dashboard print-ready?', 'print check', 'audit this dashboard for print'. Checks a dashboard's print layout: fixed vs. range size, container overflow, black-and-white color safety, and text legibility, with fix steps. Read-only.

name: dashboard-tab-order
title: Dashboard Tab Order
description: Use when the user says 'Audit my dashboard tab order', 'check tab flow', 'is my navigation logical?' Checks the order of dashboard tabs against 8 navigation rules (entry point, drill-down grouping, orphan tabs, and more) and gives drag-to-fix steps. Read-only.

name: sheet-swap-detector
title: Tableau Sheet Swap Detector
description: Use when the user says 'Duplicate worksheets', 'which sheets can I consolidate?', 'my worksheet list is a mess', 'redundant sheets'. Groups near-duplicate worksheets by type (filter, aggregation, sort, chart type, old version) and recommends how to consolidate each. Read-only.

name: worksheet-cleanup
title: Worksheet Cleanup
description: Use when the user says 'Clean up worksheets', 'remove orphan sheets', 'audit unused worksheets', 'prune this workbook'. Finds orphaned, empty, duplicate, or broken worksheets and removes them only with your consent per sheet, writing to a copy by default.

name: testing-matrix
title: Testing Matrix
description: Use when the user says 'Test this skill', 'build a testing matrix', 'QA plan for this skill'. Builds 20-25 test prompts for a Tableau Studio agent skill, walks you through them in Desktop, and on failure proposes a fix and applies it only with your approval.

name: tableau-insights-service
title: Tableau Insights Service
description: Use for business questions about metric performance, trends, changes, anomalies, drivers, goals, forecasts, or KPIs, such as 'why did X change', 'how is X trending', 'are we on track', 'what changed', 'summarize my metrics', 'how are we doing'. Try the Tableau insights service tools first, then fall back to a datasource query only when no metric fits. Do NOT trigger for workbook/dashboard layout or formatting, content-catalog navigation (use tableau-content-compass), designing or auditing Pulse metric definitions (use pulse-blueprint), or requests already scoped to raw row-level or ad-hoc SQL-style data pulls from a specific datasource (go straight to the datasource query path).

name: hyper-synthetic-forge
title: Hyper Synthetic Forge
description: Generate synthetic test data — either by cloning a Tableau datasource's schema and distributions, or from a natural language description. Triggers on 'generate test data', 'synthetic data', 'clone this datasource', 'mock data', 'sample data for testing', 'I need fake data', 'forge me some data', 'forge N rows from <schema name>', 'regenerate from saved schema', or 'hyper synthetic forge'. Do NOT use for masking or anonymizing existing files, pulling real rows, building dashboards, or publishing content.

name: pulse-blueprint
title: Pulse Blueprint
description: Design, recommend, audit, and optimize Tableau Pulse metric definitions. From business questions or datasources, produces metric blueprints with measure, time dimension, dimensions, granularity, sentiment, comparisons, and insight settings. Audits existing definitions for gaps. Triggers on 'pulse blueprint', 'recommend metrics', 'metric design', 'what should I track', 'help me with Pulse', 'create a Pulse metric' (produces a UI-ready blueprint, because this MCP has no create tool), 'audit my pulse metrics', or 'optimize my metrics'. Do NOT use for querying current metric values or insights (use the Pulse insight tools), actually creating or editing Pulse metrics, dashboard design, calculated fields, or datasource profiling.

name: tableau-calc-engine
title: Tableau Calc Engine
description: Write, debug, translate, and optimize Tableau calculated fields. Covers basic calcs, LOD expressions, table calculations, sets and set actions, dynamic zone visibility, spatial/mapping functions, string functions, parameters, and performance tuning. Triggers on "write a calc", "fix this calculation", "calculated field", "why is this returning NULL", "running total", "YoY calc", "percent of total", "rank calc", "moving average", "Top N", "LOD expression", "table calc help", "dynamic zone visibility", "MAKEPOINT", "translate this SQL to Tableau", "optimize this calc", or "tableau calc engine". Do NOT use for dashboard design or layout (Tableau Dashboard Blueprint), critiquing a finished dashboard (VizCritique Pro), Tableau Prep flows, creating or publishing workbooks, or generating test data (Hyper Synthetic Forge).

name: tableau-content-compass
title: Tableau Content Compass
description: Find the right Tableau content for a business question or topic. Given a natural language question or keyword, searches a project's views, datasources, and Pulse metrics to surface what already exists. Triggers on 'find a dashboard for', 'which view shows', 'do we have anything on', 'content compass', 'what already exists for', 'which project has', 'find the project', 'what projects are there', or any request to locate existing Tableau content by topic. Do NOT use for building dashboards (Dashboard Blueprint), evaluating a view's design (VizCritique Pro), documenting content (Tableau Scribe), auditing site health (Governance Scanner), or querying datasource data (Tableau Auto Query).

name: tableau-governance-scanner

description: Audit a Tableau site or project for governance and hygiene issues — stale content, uncertified datasources, naming violations, zero-view (ghost) workbooks, low-usage content, and missing metadata. Triggers on 'audit my site', 'governance scan', 'hygiene check', 'site health', 'stale content', 'cleanup report', or 'what needs attention on my Tableau site', 'run a scan', 'scan [project name]', or 'ghost workbooks'. Do NOT use for profiling the data quality of one datasource, critiquing a view's visual design, documenting content, writing calculations, or changing permissions or content (this skill is read-only).

name: tableau-quest
title: TableauQuest
description: Interactive choose-your-own-adventure that teaches Tableau judgment through consequences. Triggers on 'tableau quest', 'tableauquest', 'adventure mode', 'teach me tableau through a scenario', 'choose your own adventure', 'tableau simulation', 'tableau rpg', or 'tableau game'. Do NOT use for direct Tableau help, calculation writing, dashboard review, or data queries.

name: tableau-scribe
title: Tableau Scribe
description: Auto-generate Tableau dashboard documentation and metric dictionaries from live views and datasources. Two modes: Auto-Doc (full dashboard documentation from a view) and Metric Builder (field-level definitions from a datasource). Triggers on 'document this dashboard', 'generate docs', 'metric dictionary', 'define these metrics', 'tableau scribe', 'explain this view', 'what does this dashboard show?', or any request to create documentation for a Tableau view/workbook/datasource. Do NOT use for scoring or critiquing a design (use VizCritique Pro), writing or fixing calculations (use Tableau Calc Engine), designing a new dashboard (use a dashboard-planning skill), defining or auditing Pulse metric definitions (use Pulse Blueprint), or profiling data quality.

name: codex-calc-engine
title: Codex Calc Engine

name: codex-skill-creator

name: codex-synth-forge

Do not use for row-level data quality, visual-design critique, permissions assurance, or measured performance testing.

name: tableau-quest
